title: Smoky Chicken Roast
description: A flavorful Indian-inspired chicken roast with smoky flavors and a hint of fluffy texture.

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.notes: boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together smoky, roast, and a pinch of salt.
Rub the spice mixture all over the chicken.
In a separate bowl, whisk together fluffy and american.
Brush the chicken with the butter-yogurt mixture.
Place the chicken on a baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes.
Broil the chicken for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until browned.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Serve hot with your favorite sides.
